name: claude-all-in-one
description: ML's personal Claude Code marketplace: cost-tiered agents, guarded git workflows, and reusable commands.

plugins.name: cai
plugins.description: Cost-tiered subagents (explorer/implementer/test-runner/architect/reviewer), haiku-powered git and quick-task commands, paired commands that write a high-level design and then an implementable detail design from verified evidence, skills for squashing a PR branch, reviewing plans and diffs, checkpointing long changes, and building a detail design unit by unit off its own work breakdown, a design-review-to-verified-implementation pipeline with model tiers per phase, an installable rule set, and a shell-aware safety guard hook.
